visual.description: Two proportional circles showing microfiber shedding difference. Left: Standard knit polyester — small circle (87 fibers/m²/L, Accent Blue). Right: Fleece — large circle (7,360 fibers/m²/L, Accent Pink). '85×' callout between circles in JetBrains Mono. Title: 'Microfiber Shedding per Wash'. Above: opening stat '110,000 fibers per fleece jacket wash' as a header counter that ticks up before the circles appear. Source label bottom-right.
visual.sourceText: Source: Vassilenko et al., PLoS One, 2021

notes: Opening of Microplastic section. The 110K header counter draws attention first, then the scale comparison explains why fleece is particularly bad. 85x difference is dramatic enough for scale-comparison circles.
